app.title: All-sky
app.offline: The engine is not responding. I will retry on my own every few seconds.

live.title: {phase}, {state}
live.ledeNoFrame: No frame yet. If the first one does not arrive, check that the camera is connected.
live.ledeIdle: Capture has not started yet. Frames will appear here once it starts.

sky.alt: Latest frame from the all-sky camera
sky.empty: No frame yet. If the first one does not arrive, check that the camera is connected.
sky.broken: I cannot load this frame. I will retry at the next update.
sky.idle: Capture has not started yet, so there is no frame.

ribbon.title: Night from {date}
ribbon.sample: Sample band: the engine has not provided the phases yet.
ribbon.sampleNoSite: Sample band: set the site position to see the real sun altitude.
ribbon.hint: Drag the band or use the arrow keys to choose a frame.
ribbon.label: Choose a frame from the night
ribbon.empty: No frame in this night yet. If the first one does not arrive, check that the camera is connected.

problem.disconnected: I cannot find the camera. Connect it with the USB cable or over the network, or start the ASCOM simulator, then try again.
problem.error: The camera is not responding and frames have stopped. Check the USB cable or the network connection, then try again.

key.curve: The line is the Sun's altitude; the thin horizontal line is the horizon (0°).
key.lines: Dashed lines mark the phase changes.

nights.title: Nights
nights.body: Here you will review past nights, with timelapse, keogram and startrails. Coming in the next version.

color.title: Colour
color.body: Here you will adjust the sky colours with a before and after preview. Coming in the next version.

camera.title: Camera
camera.body: Here you will choose the camera and its settings. Coming in the next version.

site.title: Site
site.body: Here you will enter the observatory location. Coming in the next version.

errors.network: I cannot reach the engine. Check that it is running, then try again.
errors.timeout: The engine did not answer within a few seconds. Try again in a moment.
errors.http: The engine answered with an error. Try again; if it keeps happening, check the log.
errors.parse: The engine answered in an unexpected format. Reload the page.
errors.unknown: Something did not go as expected. Try again.
